description: Conformance corpus (ADR-0010): real saves paired with their expected ReconstructedCharacter. Baseline is KNOWN TRUTH — each expected fact is cross-checked against the reader's independent export (the `oracle` field), not against reconstruct's own output. Save bytes live out of repo (see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md in ER-save-Reader); only the expected facts are committed here. The corpus is append-only and grows one concern per slice; the seed covers identity only.
